title: Grays turning into owls in close encounter cases

tellings.quote: cases where people say they saw um grays turn into owls

plain: In some close encounter cases, people say they watched "grays", the small grey-skinned beings often described in alien encounter reports, turn into owls. The researcher Jason Jorjani mentions these cases on the show as a summary of others' accounts, drawing on the work of a writer named Mike Cleland and a book called Closer Encounters. If taken at face value, it would suggest these beings can change how they appear to witnesses.
